delivery_reason.description: Final delivery truth after any required ACK wait. Current writers always emit it, but it remains optional in v1 so envelopes written before this additive field was introduced stay valid. `delivered` and `delivery_state` preserve the immediate transport-attempt compatibility contract; target-authored receipt evidence can therefore make this field `delivered` even when those compatibility fields retain an earlier attempt state.

delivery_detail.description: One sentence naming what the caller should do about the final `delivery_reason`. Current writers always emit it; the field remains optional for pre-field v1 envelopes.

reached_target.description: Whether immediate delivery or later target-authored ACK evidence proves the message reached the target. Distinct from `delivered`, which preserves the synchronous backend-attempt compatibility contract. Current writers always emit it; the field remains optional for pre-field v1 envelopes.

queued.description: Whether the message remains durably queued after any required ACK wait. Sent-unverified, policy-rejected synchronous delivery, and failed transport attempts remain queued when their Directive landed; target-authored ACK evidence clears the flag. Current writers always emit it; the field remains optional for pre-field v1 envelopes.

target_injectability.description: Pre-wait injectability diagnosis, resolved at inject time (RCA 2026-07-09). Present on the ledger_agent path; omitted for managed sessions. Advisory only - the ACK wait is never short-circuited.
